verdict.stance: Neutral / Strategic Middle-Corridor Rail Monopoly Rebounding Post-Modernization
verdict.summary: 100% state-owned Georgian Railway is a strategic South Caucasus Middle Corridor freight monopoly with $150m cash (Sep-26) against its sole $500m 4.00% Jun-28 green Eurobond. Completion of the mainline modernization in late 2025 drove a +91% surge in 5M26 Adjusted EBITDA (GEL 122.9m) and drops capex needs going forward.

positives: 100% Government of Georgia ownership (sovereign-linked BB-) and strategic Middle Corridor transit monopoly.
Mainline modernization completed late 2025, lifting 5M26 Adj EBITDA +91% YoY to GEL 122.9m and reducing future capex.
Healthy $150m cash buffer (Sep-26) providing ~30% cash coverage of the $500m Jun-28 Eurobond.
negatives: Elevated net leverage (~4.6x-5.2x) and 100% USD Eurobond debt against partial GEL/USD revenue mix.
Freight volume volatility tied to regional transit competition and Black Sea port congestion.
EU-Georgia political friction adds sovereign spread volatility ahead of 2027-2028 refinancing window.

background.ownership_governance: 100% owned by Government of Georgia (Ministry of Economy / Partnership Fund).
